title: Tackle Low Drive Through (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the tackle is the heartbeat of rugby
Go low, drive through, wrap and squeeze
Never the head, never the neck, son

[Verse 1]
Head behind the ball carrier, cheek to the cheek of the thigh
Shoulder into the belt buckle, eyes up to the sky
Feet driving forward, twelve inches past contact
Wrap both arms around, squeeze and act

[Pre-Chorus]
Low is the rule, son, hips below the hips
Drive your legs through, dont stop the trips
Four quick steps after contact, push them back
Two metres of ground, thats the track

[Chorus]
Tackle low drive through, son
Cheek to thigh, the work begun
Shoulder to belt, wrap and squeeze
Four foot pumps, dropping them to their knees

[Verse 2]
Front on tackle, plant the lead foot outside
Side on tackle, chase the inside hip ride
From behind the chop tackle, below the knees
Three styles for three angles, son, with ease

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the head is sacred
Never lead with it, never let it stray
Cheek to cheek of the thigh, son
Thats the safe way, every single one

[Chorus]
Tackle low drive through, son
Cheek to thigh, the work begun
Shoulder to belt, wrap and squeeze
Four foot pumps, dropping them to their knees

[Outro]
Low, wrap, drive, squeeze
Four foot pumps, no tease
Head behind, cheek to thigh
Thats my boy, thats your why
